mapper.select: select id, alarm_time, last_trigger_time, trigger_count from dm_alarm_event where dedup_key = #{key} and is_deleted = 0 and alarm_status = 0 and recover_time is null and last_trigger_time >= #{since} order by last_trigger_time desc, id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into dm_alarm_event (task_id, alarm_time, source_name, alarm_msg, alarm_level, alarm_status, event_type, interface_id, process_task_id, calib_channel_id, tm_symbol, parameter_name, alarm_detail, trigger_rule, trigger_count, last_trigger_time, recover_time, dedup_key) values (#{taskId}, #{alarmTime}, #{sourceCode}, #{alarmMsg}, #{alarmLevel}, 0, #{eventType}, #{interfaceId}, #{processTaskId}, #{calibChannelId}, #{tmSymbol}, #{parameterName}, #{alarmDetail}, #{triggerRule}, #{triggerCount}, #{lastTriggerTime}, #{recoverTime}, #{dedupKey})
mapper.update: update dm_alarm_event set alarm_msg = #{alarmMsg}, alarm_detail = #{alarmDetail}, trigger_count = trigger_count + #{triggerCount}, last_trigger_time = #{lastTriggerTime}, recover_time = #{recoverTime}, alarm_level = greatest(alarm_level, #{alarmLevel}), update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
